tau_indian.name: TauIndianBankBench / NPCI tau-indian-banking
tau_indian.authors: Krishanu Adhikary, Prashant Devadiga; NPCI AI Research Team; tau2 harness Sierra Research
tau_indian.publication_note: CITATION.cff identifies software v1.0.0, released 2026-08-30; no dedicated paper URL verified. Harness papers are not a separate banking dataset.
tau_indian.license: MIT code and domain/tasks per LICENSE and HF metadata. Ten KB documents have third-party provenance; do not infer every regulatory document is relicensed MIT.
tau_indian.format: JSON tasks and DB, Markdown policy/KB, Python tools/evaluators
tau_indian.language: English task text; Indian context, not verified multilingual tasks
tau_indian.origin: Synthetic customers, balances, IDs and conversations
tau_indian.initial_state: Shared synthetic DB plus per-task active_customer override
tau_indian.mutable_state: Yes, bank service state. Soft-write service requests have distinct mutation semantics; not all tool calls debit funds.
tau_indian.expected_final_state: Derived by replaying gold actions against initial DB; not a literal final-state fixture per task
tau_indian.expected_tool_calls: Yes, argument checks and write purity
tau_indian.multi_turn: LLM customer simulator with scripted sequence/hidden info
tau_indian.policy: policy.md plus 24 KB documents and provenance.json
tau_indian.security: Confirmation, refusing duplicate destructive writes, wrong IDs and disclosure constraints; not a dedicated prompt-injection corpus
tau_indian.grader: All 1000 use ACTION+DB. Required actions and no extra writes plus normalized DB comparison; communicate checks and optional NL judge are diagnostics, not the primary reward.
tau_indian.suitability: Strong cards, mandate cancellation, state sequencing and funds/ineligibility variants. FD/RD semantics only partially map to Aster fund purchase.
tau_indian.limitations: No generic immediate-transfer execution tool despite NPCI branding. INR/UPI/IFSC, cheque, deposit interest, senior eligibility and loan rules are regional. 1000 tasks are 50 native families, not 1000 independent capabilities.

indic.name: IndicBankBench
indic.authors: Suvradip Paul, Chandra Bhushan, Harsh Sharma, Nitin Kukreja, Yatharth Dedhia, Keyur Doshi, Prashant Devadiga / NPCI
indic.publication_note: Paper September 2026; exact dataset release date not established from tagged release. Commit and HF creation dates separately recorded.
indic.license: Code MIT; case data CC BY 4.0 (DATA_LICENSE.md). Attribute NPCI and mark adaptations.
indic.format: One JSON file per case; tool schema JSON; Python deterministic mock executor and hybrid grader
indic.language: English utterances; Indian personas/regions. Name Indic does not imply Hindi/Chinese translations exist.
indic.tool_count: 32 canonical tools in tools.json; unseen-tool cases intentionally ask about unavailable capabilities
indic.schema: case_id, axis, domain, tool, target_behavior, setup, tools_exposed, user_turns, mock, gold{tool_calls,dependencies,arg_gate,expected_resolution}, grading
indic.initial_state: login_context, prior messages and per-case mock records
indic.mutable_state: Partial run-scoped state: outcome_merged carries structured changes into later reads; most outcome_fixed writes return scripted outputs, not a general financial database
indic.expected_final_state: No full final bank DB oracle; tool arguments/dependencies and response gates instead
indic.expected_tool_calls: Yes, gold calls plus required/optional argument gates
indic.multi_turn: Scripted user_turns (not the same as tau's adaptive simulated customer)
indic.policy: base_system_prompt and tool global_conventions; injected policy/context in cases
indic.security: Credential jailbreak, social engineering, third-party requests and harmful actions; separate from ordinary feature coverage
indic.grader: S1 visible resource IDs, S2 confirmation before writes (may need judge), S3 valid arguments, S4 no raw null/NaN leakage; A1-A3 action gates; response judge required; advisory quality does not change verdict
indic.suitability: Strongest complementary robustness/clarification/refusal matrix for existing primitives
indic.limitations: 799 cases / 6 source domains / 20 axes; 100 tool-signature labels are NOT 100 authored business families. A hypothetical unseen tool is a refusal test, not proof of available capability. Requires model APIs to run full evaluation, but B0 inspection does not.

agentdojo.name: AgentDojo Banking (effective suite through v1_2_2)
agentdojo.authors: ETH Zurich SPY Lab and collaborators; Debenedetti et al.
agentdojo.publication_note: Paper 2024-06; pinned repository commit 2026-06-02; version overlays resolved by class identity
agentdojo.format: Python task classes with YAML environment/injection vectors
agentdojo.origin: Synthetic environment and authored user/attacker goals
agentdojo.tool_count: 11 tools listed in banking/task_suite.py, including banking, file and user-account helpers
agentdojo.schema: UserTask: PROMPT, ground_truth, utility; InjectionTask: GOAL, security and injection constraints; environment bank_account/filesystem/user_account
agentdojo.initial_state: Shared YAML accounts, transactions, schedules and files
agentdojo.mutable_state: Yes: transactions, scheduled transactions and user account fields
agentdojo.expected_final_state: Per-task utility predicates, sometimes response substring checks; attacker success separate security predicate
agentdojo.expected_tool_calls: ground_truth FunctionCall lists, but not every utility test requires an exact trace
agentdojo.multi_turn: No adaptive customer dialogue in base banking tasks; single user goal with multiple tools
agentdojo.policy: Attack/trust-boundary rules, not a production banking policy manual
agentdojo.security: 9 distinct attack goal definitions; malicious bills/notes/history can alter payments or leak data. Do not multiply 16 by 9 and call it an observed valid case count.
agentdojo.grader: Deterministic utility/security Python checks; some read tasks use weak answer substrings
agentdojo.suitability: Best small source of history-to-payment, schedule amendment and untrusted-document risks
agentdojo.limitations: 16 user tasks + 9 attack goals, not 25 ordinary banking features. Literal IBANs, float amounts, password-changing tool and permissive transfer require redesign; never carry attacker instructions into execution.

tau_knowledge.name: Sierra tau2-bench / tau3 / tau-Knowledge banking_knowledge (one source, not three)
tau_knowledge.authors: Sierra Research; Ben Shi, Ola Zytek, Pedram Razavi, Victor Barres and collaborators
tau_knowledge.publication_note: tau3 release 2026-03-18; README notes v1.0.1 grading fixes July 2026. This audit pins newer main commit dated 2026-09-28, not falsely labeling it the v1.0.1 tag.
tau_knowledge.license: MIT repository LICENSE; fictional-bank knowledge corpus at this revision
tau_knowledge.format: 97 runtime task JSON files, shared transactional DB, JSON knowledge documents, Python tools and evaluators
tau_knowledge.origin: Fictional Rho-Bank customer/product/policy environment, synthetic tasks
tau_knowledge.tool_count: 58 decorated base KnowledgeTools + 10 decorated KnowledgeUserTools; retrieval mixins add variant-dependent tools. Not all 68 are initially visible; hidden tools are unlocked through knowledge procedures.
tau_knowledge.schema: id, user_scenario, initial_state, evaluation_criteria, user_tools, required_documents; discoverable calls carry nested actual tool names
tau_knowledge.initial_state: Shared db.json, with per-task overrides in 75/97 tasks
tau_knowledge.mutable_state: Yes, user and agent tools can update accounts/cards/disputes/referrals and discovery logs
tau_knowledge.expected_final_state: Derived DB comparison for 88 tasks (87 DB-only + 1 DB/NL); 9 action-only
tau_knowledge.expected_tool_calls: Yes, gold actions include user-requestor actions and hidden-tool names
tau_knowledge.multi_turn: Adaptive user simulator plus dual-control user tools
tau_knowledge.policy: 698 document files in pinned tree; 218 unique required documents all acquired, plus three general sample documents where distinct
tau_knowledge.security: Identity verification, procedural gates and escalation; not a dedicated adversarial attack corpus
tau_knowledge.grader: Actual runtime: 87 DB, 9 ACTION, 1 DB+NL_ASSERTION. Environment explicitly loads tasks/task_*.json; 13 differ from top-level tasks.json, which must not be used as the runtime authority.
tau_knowledge.suitability: Strong knowledge+action procedures, card servicing, disputes and internal account movement; separate KNOWLEDGE_LAYER_CANDIDATE
tau_knowledge.limitations: All 97 require documents and all have action criteria; none can honestly be counted as pure static QA from this audit. Policy-directed hidden tools and customer simulations are not missing manual Web screens. Fixed-deposit/mutual-fund suitability is not its core coverage.

banking77.name: BANKING77
banking77.authors: PolyAI; Iñigo Casanueva, Tadas Temčinas, Daniela Gerz, Matthew Henderson, Ivan Vulić
banking77.publication_note: Paper March 2020 / ACL ConvAI workshop 2020; repository snapshot commit separate
banking77.license: CC BY 4.0 (repository LICENSE), not the Apache license of third-party HF loader code
banking77.origin: Online banking query corpus per README; exact collection/anonymization not independently established, not labeled synthetic by this audit
banking77.security: User mentions of fraud/lost cards, not executable attacker tests
banking77.grader: Intent classification label, not banking action success
banking77.suitability: LANGUAGE_DATA for taxonomy and paraphrases, especially card problems, refund and payment-status wording
banking77.limitations: 10003 train + 3080 test = 13083 utterances; these are never counted as 13083 banking workflows. Existing families gain wording coverage only.

fintoolbench.name: FinToolBench
fintoolbench.authors: Double-wk / FinToolBench paper authors (see paper; author identities not inferred from handle)
fintoolbench.license: UNKNOWN: no LICENSE found in pinned repository tree. FinanceBench/OpenFinData-derived questions may carry separate rights; no raw samples redistributed.
fintoolbench.format: JSONL questions and 760-tool annotated manifest; Python evaluation
fintoolbench.origin: Adapted financial QA / research queries; not a synthetic customer banking ledger
fintoolbench.tool_count: 760 manifest lines, not 760 independently executed/verified tools in B0
fintoolbench.schema: original_idx, dataset_name, category, question, answer, context, select_tools, tool_nums, reasoning
fintoolbench.initial_state: No customer bank state; tool results depend on external financial-data providers
fintoolbench.mutable_state: No customer financial mutation demonstrated by inspected query set
fintoolbench.expected_tool_calls: Selected tool names, not necessarily full gold argument traces
fintoolbench.multi_turn: Not a tau-style adaptive customer workflow
fintoolbench.policy: Tool finance attributes include timeliness/intent/regulatory domains
fintoolbench.security: Compliance mismatch scoring, not a prompt-injection task set
fintoolbench.grader: Tool execution/capability metrics plus correctness/judge and finance attribute mismatch; evaluation needs provider access, inspection is offline
fintoolbench.suitability: Screened out of core banking capabilities; useful retrieval/compliance ideas only
fintoolbench.limitations: 295 market/company analysis queries; e.g. financial-statement metric retrieval. Do not call this 295 wealth purchase tasks. Runtime provider availability and license remain unresolved.

openbanking.name: Open Banking UK Read/Write Data API specifications
openbanking.publication_note: Inspected six OpenAPI artifacts report version 4.0.1; pinned repository commit 2026-09-18; exact tagged release date not verified
openbanking.license: Open Banking Open Licence declared in README/spec info. Linked current URL returned a Cookie Policy page during audit, so legal terms not independently revalidated; retain pointers, do not vendor specs.
openbanking.origin: Industry interface specification, not a dataset of customer tasks
openbanking.tool_count: 89 HTTP operations across six specs, not agent tools or executed cases
openbanking.schema: paths, operations, consent/payment schemas, errors and statuses
openbanking.initial_state: No runnable scenario initial bank database
openbanking.mutable_state: Defines mutation semantics but does not supply an executable bank environment
openbanking.multi_turn: Consent/payment lifecycle can inform authored scenarios; not dialogue data
openbanking.policy: Consent, SCA and regulated Open Banking assumptions
openbanking.security: Security/consent definitions, not an attack corpus
openbanking.suitability: SPECIFICATION_DERIVED evidence for scheduled payments, standing orders and consent lifecycle
openbanking.limitations: UK SCA/TPP consent is not Aster's card-bound ActionAuthorization. VRP consent deletion is not automatically identical to direct-debit mandate cancellation. No standard-conformance claim.

tau_original.name: Original tau-bench (banking-extension screening)
tau_original.format: Python airline and retail task definitions
tau_original.tool_count: Not counted: no banking domain in this repository
tau_original.schema: Task(user_id, actions, instruction, outputs) for airline/retail
tau_original.initial_state: Domain databases for airline/retail, not banking
tau_original.expected_final_state: Framework DB/action grading; no banking task
tau_original.security: Not used as a banking adversarial source
tau_original.suitability: Lineage verification; banking extension counted once under tau_knowledge
tau_original.limitations: Banking task count 0, NOT a statement that the entire tau benchmark has 0 tasks. Full unrelated-domain task inventory is outside this audit.
